purpose.question: which custody claims are shared, implementation-specific, noncomparable, or jointly absent

rust_retained_descriptor_shadow.entry_gating: private module plus default-off macOS feature plus cfg(test)-only permit constructor
rust_retained_descriptor_shadow.input_scope: one bounded file below one disposable synthetic root

python_authenticated_adapter_isolated_la.entry_gating: unregistered script plus enabled=false plus exact SYNTHETIC_KAT markers
python_authenticated_adapter_isolated_la.input_scope: fixed multi-file synthetic envelope plus public bindings and external synthetic ledger

comparison_matrix.rust: compile-time private module and test-only permit
comparison_matrix.python: runtime disabled flag and synthetic marker without MCP or crate registration
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: neither gate may be widened or treated as a production entrypoint

comparison_matrix.rust: parses raw OS bytes and rejects repeated separators dot dot-dot trailing separators NUL and overlong components
comparison_matrix.python: Path.parts is evaluated after pathlib normalization and has no explicit raw-byte grammar
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: future harness must preserve and observe pre-normalization spelling

comparison_matrix.rust: bounds absolute depth relative depth and component bytes
comparison_matrix.python: has no explicit absolute-depth relative-depth or component-byte cap
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: unknown or over-limit syntax must not be silently normalized into acceptance

comparison_matrix.rust: retains slash and every absolute ancestor descriptor through final validation
comparison_matrix.python: closes each intermediate absolute ancestor while descending and retains only final configured roots
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: a final-root descriptor is not evidence of an unchanged absolute name chain

comparison_matrix.rust: binds a disposable synthetic root but no Git common directory
comparison_matrix.python: binds repository root Git common directory path digests device inode and mount identity
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: repository identity cannot be inferred from the Rust single-file receipt

comparison_matrix.rust: re-resolves every retained directory child name from its retained parent
comparison_matrix.python: retains private directory descriptors but does not re-resolve their names from retained parents at claim time
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: parent rename and replacement remains a required differential attack

comparison_matrix.rust: uses O_RDONLY O_DIRECTORY O_NOFOLLOW O_CLOEXEC and O_NONBLOCK
comparison_matrix.python: uses O_RDONLY O_DIRECTORY O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: absence of O_NONBLOCK must remain visible in nonregular substitution analysis

comparison_matrix.rust: uses O_RDONLY O_NOFOLLOW O_CLOEXEC O_NONBLOCK and Darwin O_UNIQUE
comparison_matrix.python: uses O_RDONLY O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: pre-open st_nlink equality is not equivalent to atomic O_UNIQUE

comparison_matrix.rust: O_NONBLOCK prevents a raced FIFO or device from blocking before post-open rejection
comparison_matrix.python: pre-stats a regular file but a FIFO substitution before blocking open is not covered by an open flag
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: future probe needs a bounded child process and deterministic timeout

comparison_matrix.rust: fstatat nofollow snapshot must equal the opened descriptor snapshot
comparison_matrix.python: os.stat nofollow snapshot must equal os.fstat after open
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: same intent does not erase different metadata fields or open flags

comparison_matrix.rust: binds device inode mode links uid gid rdev size blocks block size mtime ctime birthtime flags and generation
comparison_matrix.python: binds device inode mode uid links size mtime and ctime
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: the smaller tuple cannot inherit unmeasured Darwin metadata stability

comparison_matrix.rust: reads once from the retained descriptor then checks full metadata and independent hash plus length
comparison_matrix.python: reads at capture then rereads retained descriptors inside the claim transaction precommit callback
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: record both read epochs and do not label them atomically equivalent

comparison_matrix.rust: fstatat nofollow final name must equal retained full snapshot
comparison_matrix.python: os.stat nofollow final name must equal retained reduced stat tuple
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: future receipts must report the exact compared field set

comparison_matrix.rust: requires full private-directory snapshot stability except access time
comparison_matrix.python: rechecks private-directory mount identity but does not compare directory metadata at claim time
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: directory mode owner and timestamp drift requires an explicit probe

comparison_matrix.rust: accepts only MNT_LOCAL with exact filesystem type apfs
comparison_matrix.python: accepts MNT_LOCAL filesystem types not present in a remote and FUSE denylist
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: an unknown local filesystem is unresolved rather than promoted

comparison_matrix.rust: binds device raw fsid filesystem name and number flags mount-on and mount-from names
comparison_matrix.python: binds device fsid filesystem name hashed mountpoint and local bit
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: the Python subset cannot imply mount source or full flag stability

comparison_matrix.rust: captures one bounded synthetic file
comparison_matrix.python: captures a fixed manifest packet checkpoint signature and envelope file set
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: single-file conformance cannot be lifted to set completeness or cross-file consistency

comparison_matrix.rust: does not open a public predecessor artifact set
comparison_matrix.python: retains and hashes registered public artifacts once during session construction
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: public-set binding is Python-specific and still needs name-chain timing analysis

comparison_matrix.rust: has no ledger or transaction
comparison_matrix.python: requires an owner-only external synthetic SQLite ledger on the same mount and outside the repository
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: ledger evidence must never be projected into the standalone Rust custody result

comparison_matrix.rust: has no SQLite path
comparison_matrix.python: retains a sentinel descriptor but stock SQLite opens the database again by absolute pathname
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: path re-open remains an explicit gap until a descriptor-native VFS or equivalent is reviewed

comparison_matrix.rust: returns after filesystem revalidation without a ledger transaction
comparison_matrix.python: runs filesystem revalidation inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE before later event writes and COMMIT
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: neither source proves one atomic filesystem-and-ledger linearization point

comparison_matrix.rust: has no commit boundary
comparison_matrix.python: revalidates ledger identity after commit but does not rerun custody after commit
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: mutation after precommit and before or after commit remains a required threat case

comparison_matrix.rust: all trust time replay capability and authority fields are false
comparison_matrix.python: exercises synthetic KAT trust time replay and one-use capability mechanics
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: synthetic composition cannot convert either custody profile into real authority

comparison_matrix.rust: returns static codes and messages without path errno uid inode mount or content values
comparison_matrix.python: uses fixed public input labels and can include an errno in mount-probe failure text
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: future differential receipts must contain only registered labels and classifications

comparison_matrix.rust: does not inspect Darwin extended ACL entries
comparison_matrix.python: does not inspect Darwin extended ACL entries
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: exact POSIX modes must never be described as ACL absence

comparison_matrix.rust: does not prove absence of clones snapshots or backup aliases
comparison_matrix.python: does not prove absence of clones snapshots or backup aliases
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: single-link inode evidence must not be widened to storage-copy exclusivity

comparison_matrix.rust: requires caller-supplied nonzero exact SHA-256 and byte length
comparison_matrix.python: binds captured bytes through a canonical signed synthetic envelope and registered public artifacts
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: different trust origins must remain separately named and separately falsified

comparison_matrix.rust: explicitly returns secure custody and every authority field false
comparison_matrix.python: explicitly returns production admissibility G1.4 and every real-authority field false
comparison_matrix.reconciliation_rule: no comparison outcome may change a false authority field to true
